people.name: Israel

people.line: Canaanite tribe inhabiting Jerusalem before David's conquest

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
translations.bsb: Then David and all the Israelites marched to Jerusalem (that is, Jebus), where the Jebusites inhabited the land.
translations.kjv: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
translations.asv: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (the same is Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.
